item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - BETX Fan Fest @ LA Convention Center 2025-06-08 (41, KailanFr.Fr, Keri Hilson, La Russell, Laila, Mustard, Mya)
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
This is the 2nd day, the 1st day was posted months ago.

Mustard I think is straight DJ set with a lotta hype. I was more people watching and following the catfight that broke out more than the music. I was smoking weed like crazy this day and that with total unfamiliarity with the music means that, while I was apparently having the time of my life, I was also pretty detached from what was actually going on. There might be some live guests.

I hope I got it all and got it all right as I never screenshot the set times in the app and it took a bit of detailed research to find out who it was on all these recordings long after the fact. Also didn't try too hard on the setlists.

Sneak stuff in the first pass thru Evolv then going in and out between sets for smoke breaks fully wired up with no issues.

There was civil strife just blocks away and my mom texted asking if we are under martial law.

I really wanted to go again this year but they moved it to some spot down at 60th and Central and via public transportation? Just couldn't get motivated.
